say:1:1022117001:0.source_cn: 唉，这些趾高气扬的贵族……

choice_prompt:2:1022117001.source_cn: 唉，这些趾高气扬的贵族……

say:3:1022117002:0.text: Not everyone. A friend of mine, an earl, is quite humble and kind. It's just that most nobles are arrogant and troublesome.
say:3:1022117002:0.source_cn: 不全是。例如我有一位伯爵朋友，他谦逊又温和，是个善良的...
say:3:1022117002:0.male: Not everyone. A friend of mine, an earl, is quite humble and kind. It's just that most nobles are arrogant and troublesome.
say:3:1022117002:0.female: Not everyone. A friend of mine, an earl, is quite humble and kind. It's just that most nobles are arrogant and troublesome.

say:4:1022117003:0.text: I was never afraid of battle or fighting, but I'm scared of these pretentious nobles... or, to be more precise, I loathe them.
say:4:1022117003:0.source_cn: 我这一生不曾畏惧过厮杀，却畏惧那些傲慢的贵族，或者说…...
say:4:1022117003:0.male: I was never afraid of battle or fighting, but I'm scared of these pretentious nobles... or, to be more precise, I loathe them.
say:4:1022117003:0.female: I was never afraid of battle or fighting, but I'm scared of these pretentious nobles... or, to be more precise, I loathe them.

say:5:1022117004:0.text: When I stepped into the palace with all of my achievements, I knew that the place was not for me.
say:5:1022117004:0.source_cn: 当我披着一身战绩走入王宫的那天，我便知道，我迟早有一天...
say:5:1022117004:0.male: When I stepped into the palace with all of my achievements, I knew that the place was not for me.
say:5:1022117004:0.female: When I stepped into the palace with all of my achievements, I knew that the place was not for me.

say:6:1022117005:0.text: I wield my sword for the common people in the hopes of a peaceful world, not for the nobility, who see nothing but themselves.
say:6:1022117005:0.source_cn: 我的剑，是为了世上每一家安宁的烟火而出鞘，而不是为了那...
say:6:1022117005:0.male: I wield my sword for the common people in the hopes of a peaceful world, not for the nobility, who see nothing but themselves.
say:6:1022117005:0.female: I wield my sword for the common people in the hopes of a peaceful world, not for the nobility, who see nothing but themselves.

say:8:1022117006:0.text: You're in a mood, General. Is there trouble again? I found where the bandits are hiding themselves. How about you cheer up a little?
say:8:1022117006:0.source_cn: 难得见您这么哀愁，将军。又出什么乱子了？我找到那些盗匪...

say:9:1022117007:0.text: You're just in time. You probably saw Lord Pompous Maximus just now. Follow him. Let him get in trouble a bit, and then come inform me.
say:9:1022117007:0.source_cn: 正好，刚刚那个大摇大摆的男人，你一定见到他了。你跟上去...

say:10:1022117008:0.text: Again...? At least let a man rest a bit.
say:10:1022117008:0.source_cn: 怎么又来……当真不让人喘口气吗？

choice_prompt:11:1022117008.text: Again...? At least let a man rest a bit.
choice_prompt:11:1022117008.source_cn: 怎么又来……当真不让人喘口气吗？

say:12:1022117009:0.text: You... Forget it... You're on his side.
say:12:1022117009:0.source_cn: 你——算了……你们俩是一伙的。

narration:18:1022117013:0.source_cn: 没多久，维伦让信鸽捎来了消息

say:19:1022117014:0.text: Valen says that the nobleman was kidnapped by the bandits nearby.

say:22:1022117016:0.source_cn: 维伦给我们留了记号，他在暗中跟随，不会让那贵族遇到生命危险。
